token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

as_user.desc: (Legacy) Pass true to delete the message as the authed user with `chat:write:user` scope. Bot users in this context are considered authed users. See [legacy `as_user` parameter](#legacy_as_user) below.

channel.desc: Channel containing the message to be deleted.

ts.desc: Timestamp of the message to be deleted.

cant_delete_message.desc: Authenticated user does not have permission to delete this message.

message_not_found.desc: No message exists with the requested timestamp.
